summary:
Meta stands under Colombia's national framework on gender identity and sexual orientation. Those provisions apply in full within the department and are set out in the national assessment for Colombia.

No signal specific to the department was identified. The available sources document no incident, arrest, prosecution or enforcement action involving a trans person in Meta, and no department-level institution, court ruling or administrative practice bearing on trans visitors.
tangentialFactors: Armed-group violence and internal displacement appear in the national material as the baseline against which exposure in Meta is read. No incident, threat or displacement event in the department is attributed in the sources, and the armed-group campaigns documented elsewhere in Colombia describe conditions outside Meta.
localsOnly: No service, complaint mechanism or protection programme specific to trans residents of Meta is identified in the available sources. Residents of the department fall under the same national mechanisms available elsewhere in Colombia.
outOfScopeNotes: No department-level breakdown of Colombia's recorded violence against trans people is available for Meta, so whether national patterns hold inside the department is unresolved. No source establishes the presence or reach of armed-group targeting of trans people within Meta.
